text:
maria: noticing a regression on dashboard loads after today's rollout - main bundle +360KB and heatmap frames dropping intermittently. LCP on several dashboards increased by ~900ms. anyone seeing same? :thinking_face:
leo: yep, reproducible on canary-us. looks like chart hydration is waiting on telemetry setup.
tara: I can reproduce locally. profiler shows long main-thread parse/compute coming from telemetry-schema.js. We switched to a unified schema map last week (PR 4522).
scott: I reviewed PR 4522 - it precomputes a huge mapping to validate events. That helps correctness but hoists work into startup. We should lazy compute or offload.
maria: prefer a hotfix that doesn't revert the correctness change. Options: 1) lazy-init schema, 2) move heavy mapping into a separate chunk so it isn't part of main, 3) move compute to a worker.
leo: quick win is lazy-init. minimal change and fast deploy. also add a tiny dedupe for telemetry flushes because we got a burst pattern where retries doubled the events.
tara: agreed. minimal lazy-init patch:
```
// telemetry/index.js
let schemaMap = null;
export function getSchemaMap(){
  if (!schemaMap) schemaMap = buildSchemaMap();
  return schemaMap;
}
```
This delays build until first real event.
scott: also add a short debounce before flush (150ms) to collapse duplicate immediate events. That should cut fanout from routing retries.
ci-bot: CI started for branch perf/hotfix-telemetry-lazy (build 176998.4).
maria: tara, can you open the PR with lazy-init + 150ms debounce? label as hotfix. Also add a unit that asserts schemaMap isn't constructed on module load.
tara: PR 4550 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4550 — includes lazy-init + debounce + a test.
leo: while we hotfix, we should also plan chunk split. For quick split, add a splitChunks rule targeting src/telemetry so webpack can produce a telemetry.[hash].js chunk.
scott: example rule worked for me in a draft branch:
```
optimization: {
  splitChunks: {
    cacheGroups: {
      telemetry: {
        test: /src\/telemetry/,
        name: 'telemetry',
        chunks: 'all',
        priority: 15
      }
    }
  }
}
```
(we can tune the test regex to match our repo layout)
maria: good. deploy-bot, canary please with the build from CI once green.
deploy-bot: canary deployment queued for canary-us-1 using build 176998.4.
ci-bot: build 176998.4 passed tests.
leo: I'll watch RUM dashboards and record LCP before/after. If numbers return to baseline, we can roll forward.
tara: note for postmortem: add a CI perf gate (bundle size threshold + LCP smoke) and warn on large static imports inside entry modules. I can prototype an eslint rule to detect big sync imports.
scott: also add observability: track time spent in telemetry init and how often schemaMap is built. telemetry itself should emit a small metric.
maria: agreed. immediate plan: 1) merge hotfix PR 4550 and canary; 2) monitor canary for 30m; 3) land telemetry chunking in follow-up; 4) add perf gate + import-size lint in backlog.
tara: merged and deployed to canary-us-1. CI SHA: def456.
leo: initial canary LCP delta back to baseline within 3 min. heatmap frame drops dropped in the sample sessions.
scott: nice. we should still schedule moving heavy compute to a worker for long-term.
maria: thanks all. I'll file a small RFC for telemetry split + worker offload and add perf-gate ticket to eng-platform board. :thumbsup:
